name: Signed in Secret
source:
You work the closing shift at Kingsley's Curiosities, a dusty little bookstore where nothing happens. Then Kingsley goes missing, a book with no title starts to talk, and a stranger walks in asking for it by name. Twenty-one days later you're on a train to Bancroft Academy, a magic school hidden in another world, with Athena, a 5,000-year-old woman, riding along in your head.

A remake of Bancroft Academy with a new story, planned as eight episodes in three seasons.

[Based on [url=https://moarinteractive.com/about-signed-in-secret]the official website[/url]]
